newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Dec 10.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
China's Ministry of Agriculture bans imports of poultry and poultry products from the U.S. states of Missouri and Oklahoma on reports of outbreaks of a poultry disease in those areas.

President Jiang Zemin calls on the country's medical workers to improve work ethics and resist unhealthy tendencies in market reform. Jiang urges more attention be given to developing lagging rural health care.
Vice-premier Zou Jiahua warns that excessive fixed asset investment, mounting losses of state-owned firms and a weak agricultural sector are still strong forces threatening to push up inflation.
The Ministry of Finance issues new regulations aimed at improving management of extra-budgetary funds.
